extraction.Name: Hannah Hardin
extraction.Refused/Protested: Accepted under protest, and filed April 3, 1920 in the office of the County Clerk of Pottawatomie County
extraction.Recorded patent: filed April 3, 1920 in the office of the County Clerk of Pottawatomie County
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Yes. Part of it sold and part of it mortgaged.
extraction.NOTES: In good mental, physical and financial condition. Have sold 60 acres for cash. Still have 40 acres clear. All mortgages released. No land sold for debts or taxes. None dependent on her for support. Patent delivered by Indian Agent, Green. No fraud reported.
